description: Adaptive Daily Work Plan — merges tasks from mail, chat, and calendar into one ranked daily plan.
name: Daily Consolidated Task List

steps.label: Collect calendar commitments
steps.prompt: Read today’s calendar and list all meetings/appointments, deadlines, and required prep or follow-up items. Capture fixed time constraints and open work windows between meetings.

steps.label: Extract actionable items from email
steps.prompt: Review recent and unread Outlook emails relevant to today. Extract only actionable tasks, requests, and deadlines. Ignore FYI-only messages. Tag each item with sender, due cue, and urgency signal.

steps.label: Extract actionable items from Teams
steps.prompt: Review recent Teams chats/messages for explicit asks, decisions, commitments, and pending follow-ups. Convert them into clear action items with owner (me/others), due cues, and dependency notes.

steps.label: Normalize, deduplicate, and rank
steps.prompt: Merge tasks from calendar, email, and Teams into one list. Deduplicate overlaps, combine related tasks, and rank by urgency, deadline proximity, impact, effort, and blocking dependencies.

steps.label: Produce adaptive daily work plan
steps.prompt: Generate today’s ranked plan with sections: Top 3 must-do items, Important tasks, Quick wins, and Waiting-on-others follow-ups. For each item include source, reason for priority, estimated effort, and suggested time block fitted around today’s meetings.
